A Definitive Status Symbol of the 21st Century

Ivory County rises as a serene modern sanctuary, inspired by the timeless symbolism of ivory - purity, grace, and prosperity. The project brings exquisite residences embraced by flowing greens, tranquil water elements, and artfully composed spaces crafted for those who seek a life of depth and distinction. Located in the heart of Sector 115 Noida, this curated haven blends thoughtful design, nature's quiet elegance, and a sense of effortless exclusivity. At Ivory County, every moment feels composed and every view intentionally framed, making it an ideal address for those who appreciate the rare and the remarkable.

The Essence of Ivory: Purity, Prosperity, and Perfection

Across centuries, ivory has stood as a symbol of purity, grace, and enduring prosperity - a material revered for its quiet beauty and cultural significance. At Ivory County, this timeless heritage is reimagined through contemporary architecture that feels both serene and sculptural. Forms flow with natural ease, landscapes embrace water and light, and every line is crafted to evoke balance and refinement. The project transforms the essence of ivory into living spaces that breathe tranquillity, nurture well-being, and celebrate perfection in detail. Here, tradition meets modernity, creating a masterpiece shaped for those seeking truly exceptional luxury apartment in Noida, where meaning is found in every curve and contour.

The Vision: Crafted by County Group

Developed by County Group, Ivory County is a reflection of the Group's unwavering commitment to quality, refined craftsmanship, and a deep understanding of modern living. This vision comes to life through County Group's enduring journey, marked by trust, scale, and architectural distinction.

County Group's legacy includes:

  • 35+ years of excellence, guided by integrity and innovation
  • 7000+ families who call a County project their home
  • 160 million sq. ft. delivered, setting benchmarks across Delhi/NCR
  • Iconic developments such as Cleo County, Ivy County, County 107, Cherry County, and Coco County

Ivory County stands as the next chapter in this heritage - a serene, curated address shaped for connoisseurs of fine living.

Sector 115, Noida: A Coveted Address

Set in the calm embrace of Sector 115, Ivory County enjoys a location that feels both central and quietly removed from the city's rush. The neighbourhood carries a sense of ease, well-connected yet serene, contemporary yet rooted in nature. Daily life unfolds effortlessly, with essentials, green pockets, and cultural touchpoints all within a gentle reach. This is an address that complements the project's philosophy: a place where accessibility meets tranquillity, and where every journey, whether outward or homeward, feels seamless and beautifully unhurried - an exceptional setting for premium luxury flats in Noida.

The Residences: Spaces that Breathe Sophistication

Ivory County's residences are crafted as serene extensions of contemporary elegance, where every detail is designed to elevate daily living. The thoughtfully planned 3, 4, and 5 BHK homes unfold in flowing layouts that invite natural light, creating spaces that feel open, warm, and intuitively balanced. Expansive balconies blur the boundary between indoors and nature, offering quiet corners to pause and breathe. Each home maintains a refined harmony between privacy and openness, ensuring moments of solitude coexist beautifully with areas meant for connection. Here, sophistication is not just seen, it is felt in every curated contour.

The Architecture: Where Art Meets Structure

Ivory County's architectural language is shaped by a quiet minimalism that draws deeply from nature. Clean lines, graceful proportions, and thoughtfully framed vistas create an environment that feels artful yet effortlessly functional. Beneath this elegance lies strength - an RCC-framed, earthquake-resistant structure crafted for long-term safety and stability. Water bodies weave through the landscape, sculpture gardens offer moments of stillness, and lush greens soften every path, bringing a sense of calm to the everyday. The result is an architecture where form and feeling merge, transforming Ivory County into a living canvas of tranquillity and enduring design.

The Lifestyle: Crafted for Every Mood

Life at Ivory County unfolds as a curated symphony of experiences, each space shaped to reflect a different rhythm of living. Every corner invites a feeling of calm, connection, movement, or celebration, creating a community that adapts beautifully to every mood.

Serenity and Social Grace

Elegant lounges, intimate reading rooms, refined banquet spaces, and a well-appointed business lounge offer settings where conversations flow and quiet moments find their place.

Wellness and Movement

Yoga terraces, a serene spa, a rejuvenating salon, a modern gym, and a temperature-controlled indoor pool create a sanctuary for holistic well-being.

Recreation and Celebration

A mini theatre, the Fluid Restro floating on gentle waters, the vibrant Energy Bar Café, and open event courts bring joy, indulgence, and shared memories to life.

Play and Exploration

A spirited children's zone, open-air amphitheatre, sculpture garden, and lively festival plaza inspire creativity, wonder, and everyday discovery.

At Ivory County, lifestyle becomes an art form, thoughtfully designed for every chapter of living.

The Craftsmanship: Built with Purpose and Precision

At Ivory County, every element is shaped with an artist's intent and an engineer's precision. Safety becomes a silent guardian through fire-resistant wiring, advanced detection systems, and a structure designed for enduring reassurance. Inside each home, craftsmanship reveals itself in gentle, thoughtful details - a modular kitchen that feels both functional and elegant, designer fittings that elevate the everyday, and laminated wooden flooring that adds warmth to every step. Natural ventilation and generous light turn each room into a living canvas, where premium finishes come alive with subtle texture and depth. Here, materials are not just chosen; they are curated into an experience befitting premium modern apartments in Noida.

The Community: A World in Harmony

Within Ivory County, community life unfolds with a gentle, harmonious rhythm. Landscaped walkways weave through serene greens, guiding residents to spaces that nurture both togetherness and quiet reflection. A dedicated nursery hub supports young families, while a place of worship offers a sacred haven for spiritual grounding. The amphitheatre becomes a stage for shared moments, the music area invites creative expression, and the yoga garden provides a calm refuge for mindful pauses. Every corner is designed to bring people closer to nature, to one another, and to the deeper comforts of a thoughtfully connected enclave.

The Assurance: Legacy You Can Trust

Ivory County stands on the quiet confidence of a developer known for integrity, clarity, and unwavering commitment. Promoted by ThemeCounty Pvt. Ltd., the project upholds full UP-RERA registration across its phases, reflecting transparency at every stage. County Group's reputation for on-time delivery and an unblemished track record reinforces a sense of trust that few can claim. This assurance is not spoken loudly - it is felt through decades of dependable craftsmanship and the confidence of thousands of families who have chosen the County name. Here, your investment in a distinguished luxury flat in Noida rests on a legacy built with honesty, precision, and enduring responsibility.

The Distinction: Why Choose Ivory County

Ivory County is more than a residence; it is a quiet declaration of taste and identity. Rooted in a legacy of trust and meticulous craftsmanship, it brings together art, architecture, and nature in a seamless, elevating harmony. The location offers serenity without isolation, connection without chaos - a rare balance that defines true modern living. Every space is shaped for those who prefer refinement over noise, depth over display, and timeless elegance over fleeting trends. Choosing Ivory County is choosing a life curated with intention, beauty, and enduring grace.

Super Area: Super Area includes the area enclosed by the flat's peripheral walls, half the area of common walls shared between two flats, the full area of other walls as applicable, areas under columns, cupboards, window projections and balconies, and the proportionate share of common service areas and facilities, including lobbies, staircases, circulation areas, lifts, shafts, passages, corridors, stilts, lift machine rooms, water supply facilities, maintenance offices, security rooms, and fire-control rooms. Built-up Area: Built-up Area, as per the applicable CREDAI definition, refers to the total area measured along the outer line of the unit, including balconies and/or terraces, with or without a roof; shared external walls are calculated at 50%, while other external walls are calculated at 100%, subject to applicable project documentation. Carpet Area: Carpet Area refers to the net usable floor area of an apartment, excluding external walls, service shafts, exclusive balcony or veranda areas, and exclusive open terrace areas, but including internal partition walls, in accordance with the applicable definition under the Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016 (RERA).
